items.question: Trong câu "Industry studies vary on the exact number, but the message is consistent: a large share of development effort is wasted building the wrong thing correctly.", từ "share" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Industry studies vary on the exact number, but the message is consistent: a large share of development effort is wasted building the wrong thing correctly.", what does "share" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: share /ʃeər/ (danh từ): phần, tỷ lệ. "A large share of" = một phần lớn của; ở đây là phần lớn công sức phát triển bị lãng phí.
items.explanationEn: share /ʃeər/ (noun): a portion or part. "A large share of" means a big part of something; here, a big part of development effort is wasted.

items.question: Trong câu "Industry studies vary on the exact number, but the message is consistent: a large share of development effort is wasted building the wrong thing correctly.", từ "consistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Industry studies vary on the exact number, but the message is consistent: a large share of development effort is wasted building the wrong thing correctly.", what does "consistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: consistent /kənˈsɪs.tənt/ (tính từ): nhất quán. "The message is consistent" = thông điệp nhất quán, dù các con số khác nhau. Trái nghĩa: inconsistent.
items.explanationEn: consistent /kənˈsɪs.tənt/ (adjective): staying the same. "The message is consistent" means the conclusion stays the same even though the numbers differ. Opposite: inconsistent.

items.question: Trong câu "Industry studies vary on the exact number, but the message is consistent: a large share of development effort is wasted building the wrong thing correctly.", từ "vary" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Industry studies vary on the exact number, but the message is consistent: a large share of development effort is wasted building the wrong thing correctly.", what does "vary" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vary /ˈveə.ri/ (động từ): khác nhau, dao động. "Studies vary on the number" = các nghiên cứu đưa ra con số khác nhau. Danh từ: variation.
items.explanationEn: vary /ˈveə.ri/ (verb): to differ from each other. "Studies vary on the number" means different studies give different numbers. Noun: variation.

items.question: Trong câu "Industry studies vary on the exact number, but the message is consistent: a large share of development effort is wasted building the wrong thing correctly.", từ "waste" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Industry studies vary on the exact number, but the message is consistent: a large share of development effort is wasted building the wrong thing correctly.", what does "waste" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: waste /weɪst/ (động từ): lãng phí. "Be wasted (on) doing something" = bị lãng phí vào việc gì. Danh từ: waste (sự lãng phí, rác thải).
items.explanationEn: waste /weɪst/ (verb): to use without benefit. "Be wasted doing something" means being used up for no benefit. The noun waste also means rubbish.

items.question: Trong câu "The cause is that we guess wrong about what users need, then turn the guess into requirements, then turn requirements into code — without validating at any step.", từ "validate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cause is that we guess wrong about what users need, then turn the guess into requirements, then turn requirements into code — without validating at any step.", what does "validate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to check that it is true
items.explanation: validate /ˈvæl.ɪ.deɪt/ (động từ): kiểm chứng. "Validate an idea" = kiểm chứng xem ý tưởng có đúng không trước khi làm. Danh từ: validation.
items.explanationEn: validate /ˈvæl.ɪ.deɪt/ (verb): to check that it is true. "Validate an idea" means checking that it holds before investing in it. Noun: validation.

items.question: Trong câu "These run in PARALLEL, not in sequence.", từ "in parallel" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These run in PARALLEL, not in sequence.", what does "in parallel" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in parallel /ɪn ˈpær.ə.lel/ (cụm từ): song song, cùng lúc. "Run in parallel" = chạy song song; trái với "in sequence" (tuần tự).
items.explanationEn: in parallel /ɪn ˈpær.ə.lel/ (phrase): at the same time. "Run in parallel" means happening at the same time; the opposite is "in sequence".

items.question: Trong câu "Before committing to build anything significant, ask four questions:", từ "commit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before committing to build anything significant, ask four questions:", what does "commit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (động từ): cam kết, quyết làm. "Commit to doing something" = cam kết làm gì. Trong Git, commit lại là lưu một thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (verb): to firmly decide to do. "Commit to doing something" means pledging to do it. In Git, commit means saving a change.

items.question: Trong câu "Before committing to build anything significant, ask four questions:", từ "significant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before committing to build anything significant, ask four questions:", what does "significant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: significant /sɪɡˈnɪf.ɪ.kənt/ (tính từ): đáng kể, quan trọng. "Anything significant" = bất cứ thứ gì đáng kể. Collocation: significant effort, significant risk.
items.explanationEn: significant /sɪɡˈnɪf.ɪ.kənt/ (adjective): large or important. "Anything significant" means anything sizeable. Collocations: significant effort, significant risk.

items.question: Trong câu "Nobody reads your feature description and says "this is useless" — they simply do not use it after you ship.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nobody reads your feature description and says "this is useless" — they simply do not use it after you ship.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): phát hành sản phẩm. Trong phần mềm, "ship" = phát hành cho người dùng; nghĩa gốc là vận chuyển bằng tàu.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to release a product. In software, "ship" means release to users; its original sense is to transport by boat.

items.question: Trong câu "A correct feature nobody can figure out is worth nothing.", từ "figure out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A correct feature nobody can figure out is worth nothing.", what does "figure out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: figure out /ˈfɪɡ.ər aʊt/ (cụm từ): hiểu ra, tìm ra. "Figure out how to use it" = tự hiểu ra cách dùng. Rất hay gặp trong văn nói.
items.explanationEn: figure out /ˈfɪɡ.ər aʊt/ (phrase): to come to understand. "Figure out how to use it" means work out how it is used. Very common in spoken English.

items.question: Trong câu "Answered by the development team, usually with a technical spike.", từ "spike" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Answered by the development team, usually with a technical spike.", what does "spike" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: spike /spaɪk/ (danh từ): thử nghiệm kỹ thuật ngắn. Trong Agile, "technical spike" = khoảng thời gian ngắn để thử xem có làm được không. "A spike in traffic" lại là tăng vọt.
items.explanationEn: spike /spaɪk/ (noun): a short technical experiment. In Agile, a "technical spike" is a short time-boxed investigation. "A spike in traffic" is a sudden increase.

items.question: Trong câu "A common mistake: validating only feasibility because it is the easiest to ask.", từ "feasibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common mistake: validating only feasibility because it is the easiest to ask.", what does "feasibility" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: how easy it is to use
items.explanation: feasibility /ˌfiː.zəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính khả thi. "Feasibility" = tính khả thi (làm được hay không). Tính từ: feasible.
items.explanationEn: feasibility /ˌfiː.zəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): whether it can be done. "Feasibility" is whether something can realistically be done. Adjective: feasible.

items.question: Trong câu "The goal is understanding their problem, context, and current behaviour.", từ "behaviour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The goal is understanding their problem, context, and current behaviour.", what does "behaviour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: behaviour /bɪˈheɪ.vjər/ (danh từ): hành vi, cách làm. "Current behaviour" = cách người dùng đang thực sự làm. Anh-Mỹ viết behavior.
items.explanationEn: behaviour /bɪˈheɪ.vjər/ (noun): how someone acts. "Current behaviour" is what users actually do today. American spelling: behavior.

items.question: Trong câu "Dig into real behaviour, not opinions.", từ "dig into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dig into real behaviour, not opinions.", what does "dig into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: dig into /dɪɡ ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): tìm hiểu sâu. "Dig into something" = đào sâu tìm hiểu một vấn đề. Nghĩa đen: đào xuống.
items.explanationEn: dig into /dɪɡ ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to examine closely. "Dig into something" means investigate it thoroughly. Literal sense: to dig down into.

items.question: Trong câu "Opinions are cheap; behaviour is expensive.", từ "opinion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Opinions are cheap; behaviour is expensive.", what does "opinion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: opinion /əˈpɪn.jən/ (danh từ): ý kiến, quan điểm. "Opinions are cheap" = ý kiến thì rẻ, ai cũng nói được. Cụm: in my opinion.
items.explanationEn: opinion /əˈpɪn.jən/ (noun): a personal view. "Opinions are cheap" means anyone can give one at no cost. Phrase: in my opinion.

items.question: Trong câu "Users state solutions rather than problems.", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users state solutions rather than problems.", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): nêu ra, phát biểu. "State a requirement" = nêu ra một yêu cầu. Danh từ state lại là trạng thái hoặc bang.
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say clearly. "State a requirement" means express it. The noun state means a condition or a region.

items.question: Trong câu "The moment you start persuading, the other person switches to politeness mode and you lose all your data.", từ "persuade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The moment you start persuading, the other person switches to politeness mode and you lose all your data.", what does "persuade" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: persuade /pəˈsweɪd/ (động từ): thuyết phục. "Persuade someone to do something" = thuyết phục ai làm gì. Danh từ: persuasion.
items.explanationEn: persuade /pəˈsweɪd/ (verb): to convince. "Persuade someone to do something" means convince them. Noun: persuasion.

items.question: Trong câu "The moment you start persuading, the other person switches to politeness mode and you lose all your data.", từ "politeness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The moment you start persuading, the other person switches to politeness mode and you lose all your data.", what does "politeness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: politeness /pəˈlaɪt.nəs/ (danh từ): sự lịch sự. "Politeness mode" = trạng thái chỉ nói cho lịch sự, không nói thật. Tính từ: polite.
items.explanationEn: politeness /pəˈlaɪt.nəs/ (noun): being courteous. "Politeness mode" is when people just say nice things instead of the truth. Adjective: polite.

items.question: Trong câu "After that the marginal value drops fast.", từ "marginal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After that the marginal value drops fast.", what does "marginal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: marginal /ˈmɑː.dʒɪ.nəl/ (tính từ): cận biên, thêm vào. "Marginal value" = giá trị thu thêm từ mỗi lần làm thêm (ở đây là mỗi cuộc phỏng vấn thêm).
items.explanationEn: marginal /ˈmɑː.dʒɪ.nəl/ (adjective): extra from one more unit. "Marginal value" is the extra value from one more unit — here, one more interview.

items.question: Trong câu "How many: about five to eight interviews per user group is usually enough for patterns to repeat.", từ "pattern" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How many: about five to eight interviews per user group is usually enough for patterns to repeat.", what does "pattern" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pattern /ˈpæt.ən/ (danh từ): quy luật lặp lại. "Patterns repeat" = các điểm chung bắt đầu lặp lại. Trong lập trình, design pattern là mẫu thiết kế.
items.explanationEn: pattern /ˈpæt.ən/ (noun): a repeated regularity. "Patterns repeat" means the same themes keep coming back. In code, a design pattern is a reusable template.

items.question: Trong câu "Every product idea is a stack of assumptions.", từ "stack" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every product idea is a stack of assumptions.", what does "stack" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stack /stæk/ (danh từ): chồng, đống. "A stack of assumptions" = một chồng giả định xếp lên nhau. Trong CNTT còn có tech stack, call stack.
items.explanationEn: stack /stæk/ (noun): a pile of things. "A stack of assumptions" is a pile of them on top of each other. In IT there is also tech stack, call stack.

items.question: Trong câu "Every product idea is a stack of assumptions.", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every product idea is a stack of assumptions.", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (danh từ): giả định. "Make an assumption" = đưa ra giả định. Động từ: assume.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (noun): something believed without proof. "Make an assumption" means believe something without proof. Verb: assume.

items.question: Trong câu "If this assumption is wrong, does the whole idea collapse?", từ "collapse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If this assumption is wrong, does the whole idea collapse?", what does "collapse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: collapse /kəˈlæps/ (động từ): sụp đổ. "The idea collapses" = ý tưởng sụp đổ hoàn toàn. Trong giao diện, collapse a panel = thu gọn.
items.explanationEn: collapse /kəˈlæps/ (verb): to fall apart. "The idea collapses" means it falls apart. In a UI, collapse a panel means fold it up.

items.question: Trong câu "Do we have any evidence for it yet?", từ "evidence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do we have any evidence for it yet?", what does "evidence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): bằng chứng. "Evidence for something" = bằng chứng ủng hộ điều gì. Là danh từ không đếm được.
items.explanationEn: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (noun): proof or supporting facts. "Evidence for something" is proof that supports it. It is uncountable.

items.question: Trong câu "A ladder of experiments from cheap to expensive:", từ "ladder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A ladder of experiments from cheap to expensive:", what does "ladder" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ladder /ˈlæd.ər/ (danh từ): thang bậc, cấp độ. "A ladder of experiments" = dãy thử nghiệm xếp theo bậc từ rẻ đến đắt. Nghĩa đen: cái thang.
items.explanationEn: ladder /ˈlæd.ər/ (noun): a graded series of steps. "A ladder of experiments" is a series ordered by step, cheap to expensive. Literal sense: a ladder you climb.

items.question: Trong câu "The principle: always pick the cheapest experiment that could DISPROVE the assumption.", từ "disprove" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The principle: always pick the cheapest experiment that could DISPROVE the assumption.", what does "disprove" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: disprove /dɪsˈpruːv/ (động từ): bác bỏ, chứng minh sai. "Disprove an assumption" = chứng minh giả định là sai. Đừng nhầm với disapprove (không tán thành).
items.explanationEn: disprove /dɪsˈpruːv/ (verb): to show to be false. "Disprove an assumption" means show it is false. Do not confuse with disapprove.

items.question: Trong câu "You do not need perfect evidence; you need enough evidence to dare take the next step.", từ "dare" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You do not need perfect evidence; you need enough evidence to dare take the next step.", what does "dare" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dare /deər/ (động từ): dám (làm gì). "Dare (to) do something" = dám làm gì; có thể bỏ "to". "I dare you" lại là thách ai.
items.explanationEn: dare /deər/ (verb): to be brave enough to. "Dare (to) do something" means be brave enough to do it; "to" may be dropped. "I dare you" is a challenge.

items.question: Trong câu "An MVP is small in SCOPE, not low in quality — a buggy MVP only teaches you that users dislike bugs", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An MVP is small in SCOPE, not low in quality — a buggy MVP only teaches you that users dislike bugs", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi. "Small in scope" = phạm vi nhỏ (ít tính năng). Cụm: out of scope, scope creep.
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (noun): the range covered. "Small in scope" means covering few things. Phrases: out of scope, scope creep.

items.question: Trong câu "If all three phases are already decided, that is not an MVP, that is incremental delivery", từ "incremental" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If all three phases are already decided, that is not an MVP, that is incremental delivery", what does "incremental" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incremental /ˌɪŋ.krəˈmen.təl/ (tính từ): tăng dần từng phần. "Incremental delivery" = giao hàng từng phần tăng dần. Trạng từ: incrementally.
items.explanationEn: incremental /ˌɪŋ.krəˈmen.təl/ (adjective): done in small added steps. "Incremental delivery" means delivering in successive small pieces. Adverb: incrementally.

items.question: Trong câu "An MVP reduces the risk of learning wrong; saving is only a side effect", từ "side effect" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An MVP reduces the risk of learning wrong; saving is only a side effect", what does "side effect" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: side effect /ˈsaɪd ɪˌfekt/ (cụm từ): tác dụng phụ. "A side effect" = kết quả phụ, không phải mục đích chính. Trong lập trình còn chỉ hàm làm thay đổi trạng thái bên ngoài.
items.explanationEn: side effect /ˈsaɪd ɪˌfekt/ (phrase): a secondary result. "A side effect" is a secondary, unintended result. In programming it also means a change outside a function.

items.question: Trong câu "With no answer, you are not doing an MVP — you are delivering incrementally under a fancier name.", từ "fancy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With no answer, you are not doing an MVP — you are delivering incrementally under a fancier name.", what does "fancy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fancy /ˈfæn.si/ (tính từ): hoa mỹ, kêu hơn. "Under a fancier name" = dưới một cái tên nghe kêu hơn nhưng bản chất không đổi.
items.explanationEn: fancy /ˈfæn.si/ (adjective): more showy. "Under a fancier name" means with a grander-sounding label but the same substance.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not forget the MVP's hidden cost: a poor MVP released to real customers can damage trust and cost you the chance to try again with those same people.", từ "damage" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not forget the MVP's hidden cost: a poor MVP released to real customers can damage trust and cost you the chance to try again with those same people.", what does "damage" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: damage /ˈdæm.ɪdʒ/ (động từ): làm tổn hại. "Damage trust" = làm tổn hại niềm tin. Danh từ damage cũng là sự thiệt hại.
items.explanationEn: damage /ˈdæm.ɪdʒ/ (verb): to harm. "Damage trust" means harm people's confidence in you. The noun damage means harm done.

items.question: Trong câu "Four traps when interpreting results:", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four traps when interpreting results:", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
options: cái bẫy, sai lầm dễ mắc
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): cái bẫy, sai lầm dễ mắc. "Fall into a trap" = mắc bẫy. Ở đây là những sai lầm dễ gặp khi đọc kết quả.
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): an easy-to-fall-into mistake. "Fall into a trap" means make a tempting mistake. Here, common errors when reading results.

items.question: Trong câu "You remember the three who praised it and forget the seven who shrugged.", từ "shrug" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You remember the three who praised it and forget the seven who shrugged.", what does "shrug" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shrug /ʃrʌɡ/ (động từ): nhún vai (thờ ơ). "Shrug" = nhún vai, thể hiện thờ ơ, không quan tâm. Cụm: shrug off (gạt đi).
items.explanationEn: shrug /ʃrʌɡ/ (verb): to raise shoulders indifferently. "Shrug" means lift the shoulders to show indifference. Phrase: shrug something off.

items.question: Trong câu "The defence: write success criteria BEFORE running the experiment.", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The defence: write success criteria BEFORE running the experiment.", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. Số ít criterion, số nhiều criteria. "Success criteria" = tiêu chí thành công.
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (noun): a standard for judging. Singular criterion, plural criteria. "Success criteria" are the standards that define success.

items.question: Trong câu "Mistaking politeness for need.", từ "mistake for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mistaking politeness for need.", what does "mistake for" (phrase) mean?
options: nhầm cái này thành cái kia
đổi cái này lấy cái kia
optionsEn: to wrongly take one as another
items.explanation: mistake for /mɪˈsteɪk fɔːr/ (cụm từ): nhầm cái này thành cái kia. "Mistake A for B" = nhầm A là B; ở đây nhầm sự lịch sự là nhu cầu thật.
items.explanationEn: mistake for /mɪˈsteɪk fɔːr/ (phrase): to wrongly take one as another. "Mistake A for B" means wrongly think A is B; here, taking politeness to be real need.

items.question: Trong câu "Five interviews with your own colleagues says nothing about the market.", từ "colleague" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Five interviews with your own colleagues says nothing about the market.", what does "colleague" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: colleague /ˈkɒl.iːɡ/ (danh từ): đồng nghiệp. "Colleague" = người làm cùng công ty; phỏng vấn đồng nghiệp là mẫu sai.
items.explanationEn: colleague /ˈkɒl.iːɡ/ (noun): a co-worker. "Colleague" is someone you work with; interviewing them gives the wrong sample.

items.question: Trong câu "Not separating signal from noise.", từ "noise" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not separating signal from noise.", what does "noise" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: noise /nɔɪz/ (danh từ): thông tin nhiễu. "Signal vs noise" = tín hiệu thật vs thông tin nhiễu không có ý nghĩa. Nghĩa thường: tiếng ồn.
items.explanationEn: noise /nɔɪz/ (noun): irrelevant random data. "Signal vs noise" contrasts meaningful information with random clutter. Everyday sense: loud sound.

items.question: Trong câu "One very loud user does not represent a thousand silent ones.", từ "represent" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One very loud user does not represent a thousand silent ones.", what does "represent" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: represent /ˌrep.rɪˈzent/ (động từ): đại diện cho. "Represent a group" = đại diện cho một nhóm. Tính từ: representative (mang tính đại diện).
items.explanationEn: represent /ˌrep.rɪˈzent/ (verb): to stand for. "Represent a group" means stand for them. Adjective: representative.

items.question: Trong câu "But conversely, feedback repeating at the third and fourth person is already a pattern.", từ "conversely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But conversely, feedback repeating at the third and fourth person is already a pattern.", what does "conversely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: conversely /ˈkɒn.vɜːs.li/ (trạng từ): ngược lại. "Conversely" = ngược lại, dùng để nêu ý đối lập với câu trước.
items.explanationEn: conversely /ˈkɒn.vɜːs.li/ (adverb): on the other hand. "Conversely" introduces the opposite point to what was just said.

items.question: Trong câu "Discovery's most valuable outcome is a decision NOT to build.", từ "outcome" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Discovery's most valuable outcome is a decision NOT to build.", what does "outcome" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (danh từ): kết quả. "Outcome" = kết quả cuối cùng. Cụm hay gặp: outcome over output (kết quả hơn sản lượng).
items.explanationEn: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (noun): a result. "Outcome" is the end result. Common phrase: outcome over output.

items.question: Trong câu "Every time you kill an idea after two days of testing instead of two months of coding, discovery has paid for itself.", từ "pay for itself" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every time you kill an idea after two days of testing instead of two months of coding, discovery has paid for itself.", what does "pay for itself" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to save more than it cost
items.explanation: pay for itself /peɪ fɔːr ɪtˈself/ (cụm từ): tự bù đắp chi phí. "Pay for itself" = khoản đầu tư tự bù lại chi phí nhờ lợi ích mang lại.
items.explanationEn: pay for itself /peɪ fɔːr ɪtˈself/ (phrase): to save more than it cost. "Pay for itself" means an investment returns more than it cost.

items.question: Trong câu "If your team has never chosen the third, your discovery is a ritual.", từ "ritual" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If your team has never chosen the third, your discovery is a ritual.", what does "ritual" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ritual /ˈrɪtʃ.u.əl/ (danh từ): nghi thức hình thức. "A ritual" = nghi thức; ở đây là làm cho có, không thực sự ảnh hưởng quyết định.
items.explanationEn: ritual /ˈrɪtʃ.u.əl/ (noun): an empty routine. "A ritual" is a ceremony; here, a routine done for show that never changes decisions.

items.question: Trong câu "Teams tend to validate only feasibility because it is the one question someone in the room can answer.", từ "tend to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Teams tend to validate only feasibility because it is the one question someone in the room can answer.", what does "tend to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: tend to /tend tuː/ (cụm từ): có xu hướng. "Tend to do something" = thường có xu hướng làm gì. Danh từ: tendency.
items.explanationEn: tend to /tend tuː/ (phrase): to usually do. "Tend to do something" means usually do it. Noun: tendency.

items.question: Trong câu "Discovery exists to reduce the risk of building the wrong thing, and it must run continuously alongside delivery.", từ "alongside" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Discovery exists to reduce the risk of building the wrong thing, and it must run continuously alongside delivery.", what does "alongside" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: alongside /əˌlɒŋˈsaɪd/ (giới từ): song song với. "Alongside something" = đi cùng, song song với cái gì.
items.explanationEn: alongside /əˌlɒŋˈsaɪd/ (preposition): together with. "Alongside something" means together with or next to it.

items.question: Trong câu "Four risk types deserve deliberate validation, especially value risk since it is the easiest to skip.", từ "deserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four risk types deserve deliberate validation, especially value risk since it is the easiest to skip.", what does "deserve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: deserve /dɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): xứng đáng được. "Deserve attention" = đáng được chú ý.
items.explanationEn: deserve /dɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to merit. "Deserve attention" means merit attention.

items.question: Trong câu "Four risk types deserve deliberate validation, especially value risk since it is the easiest to skip.", từ "deliberate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four risk types deserve deliberate validation, especially value risk since it is the easiest to skip.", what does "deliberate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: deliberate /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət/ (tính từ): có chủ đích. "Deliberate" = có chủ ý, cân nhắc kỹ. Trạng từ: deliberately.
items.explanationEn: deliberate /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət/ (adjective): done on purpose. "Deliberate" means intentional and carefully considered. Adverb: deliberately.

items.question: Trong câu "An MVP is a learning tool rather than a trimmed release, and its stopping criteria must be written first.", từ "trim" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An MVP is a learning tool rather than a trimmed release, and its stopping criteria must be written first.", what does "trim" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trim /trɪm/ (động từ): cắt bớt, tỉa gọn. "A trimmed release" = bản phát hành đã bị cắt bớt tính năng. Trong code: trim() bỏ khoảng trắng.
items.explanationEn: trim /trɪm/ (verb): to cut down. "A trimmed release" is a release with features cut out. In code, trim() removes whitespace.
